headline: Netflix launches AI-powered Discover tab for streaming recommendations
summary: Netflix is rolling out a new AI-driven Discover tab meant to help users decide what to watch. TechCrunch reports the first experimental feature recommends titles based on the viewer's current mood, while Engadget describes the initial suggestions as built around a range of AI-generated themes rather than mood.
